title: `return"field" in Module` will be evaluated as `returntrue` or `returnfalse`
body:
<!-- Please don't delete this template because we'll close your issue -->
<!-- Before creating an issue please make sure you are using the latest version of webpack. -->

# Bug report
Hi, Webpack team. I found a bug when I upgrade it's version in my work project.

in version 5.71.0, there is a commit eb5d12415052b58098aee261c42ffc85aa20b03b.
It can evaluate the statement like `"Component" in React` to `true` on build time.
However, the is a edge case:
``` js
function foo() {
  return"Component" in "React"
}
```
that will be transformed to "returntrue". It misses a space before "true"

<!-- Please ask questions on StackOverflow or the webpack Gitter. -->
<!-- https://stackoverflow.com/questions/ask?tags=webpack -->
<!-- https://gitter.im/webpack/webpack -->
<!-- Issues which contain questions or support requests will be closed. -->

**What is the current behavior?**
`returntrue` or `returnfalse` will be a transformed result.
And will cause runtime error as `returntrue is not defined`

**If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce.**
## reproduce
I create a PR for fix it. #15760.
comment this line https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/15760/files#diff-82d9a7fff0d25b8895057d34b65f83eb05cc28f11ed58132609ea7c565030745R113
and run 
```
 yarn jest test/TestCasesDevelopment.test.js -t harmony-export-import-specifier
```
the test will produce an error:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20639676/166406584-048e716f-bcd4-4444-a321-44fbb368354e.png)
